title: Personal LLM mini-sheet: experiment tracker (Maya Chen)
content:
Mini experiment tracker (quick sheet)

Columns: id, date, model, variant, temp, top_p, tokens, batch_size, latency_ms, pass@1, notes

1, 2026-02-10, gpt4o-mini, base prompt v1, 0.7, 0.9, 150, 1, 120, 0.62, initial run - weird hallucination on pricing table
2, 2026-02-11, redwood-13b-q4, instruct-tweak-A, 0.2, 0.95, 120, 2, 95, 0.74, better on instructions, lower latency w/ q4
3, 2026-02-18, redwood-13b-q4, instruct-tweak-B, 0.2, 0.95, 120, 2, 90, 0.76, small prompt reformat improved pass@1
4, 2026-02-21, redwood-13b-q8, instruct-tweak-B, 0.2, 0.95, 120, 2, 80, 0.73, quantized reduced latency, slight drop in accuracy
5, 2026-02-25, gpt4o-mini, base prompt v2, 0.5, 0.9, 160, 1, 110, 0.65, fixed prompt phrasing, still occasional truncation
6, 2026-02-28, redwood-33b, long-context-probe, 0.3, 0.9, 800, 1, 240, 0.82, testing 8k context, memory OK but slow

Quick metrics (Feb subset):
- avg_latency_ms: 119
- avg_pass@1: 0.72
- median_tokens: 145

Notes/Triage:
- 02-10 hallucination: reproduce w/ smaller prompt, isolate system vs user instructions
- Quantized q8 looks promising for latency but retest across prompt types (tables, Q&A)
- Need to add KV-cache warmup test for long context runs

TODOs:
- [ ] Add column for warmup_tokens and cache_hit_rate
- [ ] Hook up to eval harness (linked PROJ-4578) to compute BLEU/EM for structured outputs
- [ ] Share with Samir for input on new prompt templates

Personal notes (scratch):
- Keeping this mini-sheet as my quick daily log. Not canonical; will move to shared eval spreadsheet once stable.
- Might try batching=4 experiments for production-sim later this month.

Snippets: prompt v2 (short)
"System: You are a helpful assistant. Provide concise, bulletized answers and include a short summary.
User: Given the pricing table below, identify anomalies and propose three fixes."

End of sheet.
